accepted.quote: I offered an amendment then which would have extended that statute of limitations for those who committed unemployment insurance fraud during the pandemic.
accepted.rationale: Thompson states he previously sought to extend the limitations period for pandemic unemployment insurance fraud.

accepted.quote: So, while we are extending the time period for which law enforcement can prosecute those who committed fraud, we are taking away funding to prevent future fraud.
accepted.rationale: Thompson criticizes taking away funding used to prevent unemployment insurance fraud, indicating support for continued fraud-prevention funding.
